AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP.description: Default Azure Resource Group name for cloud provisioning operations.

AZURE_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install AZURE. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

AZURE_CONTAINER.description: Azure Blob Storage container name used for cloud artifact transfers.

AZURE_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading azure binary or archive artifacts.

AZURE_IMAGE_NAME.description: Azure VM image URN or gallery image identifier used when provisioning compute instances.

AZURE_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying azure available remote releases.

AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT.description: Azure Storage Account name associated with cloud state or blob artifacts.

AZURE_VERSION.description: Specific version of azure to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).
